# Syncity

> Three senior software consultants specializing in long-term product and platform work. No handoffs, no account managers — we embed in your team and stay.

## About

Syncity is a boutique software consultancy based in Croatia. We take on long-term engagements where we work as an extension of the client's team. We do not do short sprints, handoffs, or fixed-scope deliveries — our model is built around continuity and ownership.

## Team

- **Dominik Košćica** — Mobile & Flutter engineer, team lead. 9+ years in the industry, Master's in Software Engineering. Specializes in mobile architecture and cross-platform development (Flutter, Go).
- **Adrian Bićanić** — Senior Front-End engineer. Specializes in web application development with JavaScript, TypeScript, and React. Also works on AI-integrated web products.
- **Andrija Kapetanović** — Front-End developer. Specializes in React, web performance, and accessible UI. Focused on design-accurate, production-quality interfaces.

## Services

- Web application development (React, TypeScript, TanStack)
- Mobile application development (Flutter, iOS, Android)
- Long-term team embedding and technical ownership
- Code review and technical advisory

## How We Work

We prioritize long-term engagements over short projects. We believe in staying with a product long enough to understand it deeply — not shipping and moving on. Clients work directly with the engineers doing the work, not through an account layer.
